desc:
Master the Infinity Gauntlet. DOOMSDAY is here...

An independent simulator and solo passion project started in 2025.

V0.7 — DOOM Update
• New Doctor Doom boss fight and arena near the time stone gate.
• Earn Doom Gauntlets FREE: defeat Doom, collect his Broken Gauntlet and repair it at Nidavellir.
• Wield Magic and Technology modes. Summon Doombots.
• Increased Thunder Slam damage.
• Improved spawning, streaming and mobile performance.
• Various bug fixes.

Defeat enemies, unlock all six Infinity Stones and rebirth.

Power | Space | Reality | Time | Soul | Mind

Each Stone has unique abilities and its own world. Unleash the Snap, forge Stormbreaker, or defeat the three cave Valkyries and forge Mjolnir.

Controls:
M1 — Attack
Q/E/R/T — Abilities
F — Block
1–6 — Select Stones
Stormbreaker: Q/M2 — Aim | Q/R — Recall

V0.7 BETA — Development is ongoing. Please report bugs and share feedback. More story, lore, weapons and tools are coming!

badges.name: Welcome, Titan
badges.desc: You have entered the multiverse. Take your first step toward becoming the most powerful being in the universe.

badges.name: Power Stone Unlocked
badges.desc: Contained within the Orb, the Power Stone holds enough energy to destroy entire worlds. Only beings of extraordinary strength can wield it.

badges.name: Unlocked Stormbreaker
badges.desc: You have claimed Stormbreaker. Throw and recall it, deal splash lightning damage, and chain attacks between nearby enemies.

badges.name: Unlocked Mjolnir
badges.desc: Defeat the three Valkyries hidden within the caves, then forge the hammer at Nidavellir.  Prove yourself worthy of wielding the legendary Mjolnir.

badges.name: Space Stone Unlocked
badges.desc: Encased within the Tesseract, the Space Stone grants its wielder dominion over space itself, allowing them to traverse the universe in an instant.

badges.name: Reality Stone Unlocked
badges.desc: Once known as the Aether, the Reality Stone grants its wielder the power to reshape existence, bending the very laws of reality to their will.

badges.name: Soul Stone Unlocked
badges.desc: Hidden upon the desolate world of Vormir, the Soul Stone demands a terrible sacrifice. A soul for a soul.

badges.name: Time Stone Unlocked
badges.desc: Once protected within the Eye of Agamotto, the Time Stone grants mastery over the flow of time, allowing its wielder to witness, alter and reverse events.

badges.name: Mind Stone Unlocked
badges.desc: Once concealed within Loki's sceptre, the Mind Stone possesses the power to influence consciousness, control minds and unlock unimaginable intelligence.

badges.name: You should have gone for the head....
badges.desc: Snap your fingers with all 6 infinity stones. The hardest choices require the strongest wills

badges.name: You met the creator!
badges.desc: You met the owner! Thanks for playing!

badges.name: Defeated the Tesseract Trial (Early Access)
badges.desc:
The Tesseract has claimed many. Not you. You were never meant to make it this far.

A reward is currently still in development.

badges.name: Eitri's Favor
badges.desc: Deep within the Forge of Nidavellir, you have answered Eitri's call and successfully completed his trial.

badges.name: Tesseract's Chosen
badges.desc: You have reached Wave 20 of the Tesseract Trial, enduring what was thought impossible. Countless challengers have fallen, but you have proven yourself worthy of the Tesseract's power.

badges.name: 5,000 Enemies Eliminated
badges.desc: You have claimed 5000 souls. The hardest choices require the strongest wills.

badges.name: 10,000 Enemies Eliminated
badges.desc: You have claimed 10,000 souls. Power is not given, it is earned.
